definitions.gloss: falling object; fallen debris; dropped item
definitions.explanation: An object that has fallen or may fall from a height. Commonly used in safety warnings, traffic reports, and construction contexts.

examples.japanese: {落下物|らっかぶつ}に{注意|ちゅうい}。
{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}に{落下物|らっかぶつ}があった。
examples.english: There was fallen debris on the highway.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}では{落下物|らっかぶつ}による{事故|じこ}を{防|ふせ}ぐため、ヘルメットの{着用|ちゃくよう}が{義務|ぎむ}づけられている。
examples.english: At construction sites, wearing helmets is mandatory to prevent accidents from falling objects.

notes:
Commonly seen on highway signs, construction site warnings, and safety notices. A compound of {落下|らっか} (falling) and {物|ぶつ} (object).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落下物|らっかぶつ}に{注意|ちゅうい}: caution for falling objects
- {落下物|らっかぶつ}{事故|じこ}: falling object accident
- {落下物|らっかぶつ}を{回避|かいひ}する: to avoid a falling object
- {道路|どうろ}の{落下物|らっかぶつ}: debris on the road

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {落下|らっか}: falling; dropping — the act of falling itself
- {落石|らくせき}: falling rocks; rockfall — specifically rocks falling on roads or mountainsides
- {飛来物|ひらいぶつ}: flying object; airborne debris — objects carried by wind or an explosion
